Moreover, the CMA provides no calibrated probability of sale or statistical confidence interval, leaving the “range” purely descriptive. These gaps mean the anchors ($719,400 – $738,100) should be treated as rough guides only, and the underlying assumptions need independent verification before any pricing decision.
